entries.description: But take some woman or man who isn’t irritable and bad-tempered
entries.subject: But
entries.object: some woman or man who isn’t irritable and bad-tempered

spans.text: Idha pana, māṇava, ekacco itthī vā puriso vā akkodhano hoti anupāyāsabahulo; But take some woman or man who isn’t irritable and bad-tempered.
Idha pana, māṇava, ekacco itthī vā puriso vā anissāmanako hoti; But take some woman or man who is not jealous …
But take some woman or man who does give to ascetics or brahmins …
Idha pana, māṇava, ekacco itthī vā puriso vā atthaddho hoti anatimānī; But take some woman or man who is not obstinate and arrogant …
